next.reason: A run-time requirement became an exception condition. 1985: 'The value of the subscript must be a positive integer ... The highest permissible occurrence number ... is the maximum number of occurrences ... in the associated OCCURS clause' (§1985:IV.4.3.8.2.4 GR1), with no stated result when violated. 2023 keeps the range ('The value of a subscript shall be a positive integer', §2023:8.4.2.3.4 GR2) and adds 'If the value of the subscript is not a positive integer or is less than one or is greater than the highest permissible occurrence number, the EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT exception condition is set to exist'; this fatal condition, unchecked by default (§2023:14.6.13.1.1), leaves continuation to the implementor (§2023:14.6.13.1.3 GR8). It also adds a case: for a dynamic-capacity table the highest occurrence 'is implementor-defined'. GR-8.4.2.3.4-1 (determining the subscript) states none of this rule.
